steps.title: Configure Android Manifest permissions and service declarations
steps.description: Declare foreground service permissions, media playback service type, internet access, wake locks, and register BackgroundAudioService and activities.

steps.title: Set up application dependencies and Gradle configuration
steps.description: Define Java 8 source compatibility, compile and target SDK version 34, minimum SDK 21, and application packaging parameters.

steps.title: Create app metadata configuration
steps.description: Define application metadata including app_name, package_name, and app_id for runtime context initialization.

steps.title: Define UI color palette and style resources
steps.description: Create dark theme color definitions including YouTube red accent, surface colors, text primary, and background styles.

steps.title: Implement custom BackgroundWebView subclass
steps.description: Create BackgroundWebView to override onWindowVisibilityChanged and prevent Android WebKit native C++ audio engine from auto-pausing media on screen lock or app minimize.

steps.title: Design main activity layout with BackgroundWebView frame
steps.description: Construct layout using standard UI elements and integrate BackgroundWebView to maintain continuous rendering when hidden.

steps.title: Implement watch history SQLite database manager
steps.description: Build HistoryDbHelper to handle creation, insertion, retrieval, and deletion of user watch history records.

steps.title: Develop foreground media session service for background audio
steps.description: Implement BackgroundAudioService with MediaSession, AudioFocus handling, PowerManager WakeLock, and system audio notification controls.

steps.title: Implement dynamic JavaScript bridge and screen-off lock listener
steps.description: Inject visibility API overrides, HTMLMediaElement pause method interception, AudioContext resume loop, and broadcast receivers for uninterrupted playback when app is minimized or screen is locked.

steps.title: Building YouTube Background Player
steps.description: Final build, verification, and APK assembly.
